page_title: Configure the number of days to save video
page_content:
[TOC]

### Prerequisites:
- Display, remote control, storage media (SD card, hard disk, etc.)

### Operation steps
1. Press the remote control [ENTER] button to enter the login interface, enter the password "999999", and automatically log in to the main menu
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=de5385f5da980f88b81f446830608e6f)

2. Select [Settings] on the main menu interface and press the "ENTER" button to enter the settings interface
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=54a57d4f22fb1af167a029fa05029135)

3. Select [Record] in the [Settings] interface, and press the "ENTER" key to enter the recording settings interface
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=9ae9336c796f92916b36cf95616d5c15)

4. Select [Record] in the [Recording Settings] interface to enter the recording interface, check the number of days to save the recording, set the required number of days, and press OK to save and take effect.
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=13ee4c148a8a57f2c1dede949b6f5e75)
